plan.inputs: original PassBench replay; all candidates for a graph receive the same tensors
plan.order: seeded shuffle of distinct executable fingerprints each repeat; exact artifact aliases share measurements
metrics: synchronized end-to-end ms including output/scratch allocation and final synchronization
CUDA event stream elapsed ms, including dispatch gaps; not pure device kernel duration
plan.selection: training-only, family-balanced geometric mean end-to-end speedup; exact ties use candidate declaration order; any correctness/stability failure excludes candidate; compile-cost coefficient 0
plan.heldout: only unchanged compiler and training-selected policy; no candidate grid on held-out timing
plan.scope: exploratory development study from previously observed evaluation tasks; not an untouched paper benchmark
